summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC, a UK-incorporated foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE, filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market repurchases under its $500 million buyback program announced July 1, 2025. The company bought 330,400 ordinary shares across two settlements: 262,200 shares delivered September 18, 2026 at $10.41-$11.00, and 68,200 delivered September 28, 2026 at $10.19-$10.36, for an aggregate $3,496,764.89. Shares are held in treasury. No advisor or board recommendation stated. Watch remaining program capacity and pace of further 6-K buyback disclosures.
